# ObjectBuilder

**Interface** · `ironwood.pool.ObjectBuilder`

```java
public interface ObjectBuilder<E extends Object>
```

Creates independent objects for an owning pool.



The compiler requires each non-null result to be fresh and unescaped.
Implementations must not publish themselves from [`newInstance()`](#member-newInstance-28--29-).
A cached, borrowed, or externally published object cannot be a factory result.
A null result leaves a preload slot empty and fails a checkout.

**Parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<E>` | the reference type created by this builder |
